body.x: FCI (Fuel Cell Innovations, CEO Tae-won Lee) participated in the CES 2023 held in Las Vegas, USA, at the 'Seoul Tech Pavilion' in the Las Vegas Convention Center(LVCC) for a total of 4 days from January 5 (Thursday) to January 8 (Sunday, local time).

FCI is a global company that provides innovative energy solutions for a sustainable, low-carbon society, and is a joint venture established by investing technology and capital from Korea and Saudi Arabia to foster the energy industry for the realization of Korea's ‘Hydrogen Economy’ and Saudi Arabia's ‘Circular Carbon Economy'. They are in the process of providing clean energy solutions based on high-temperature fuel cells and solid oxide electrolysis (SOE) technology including SOFC and MCFC and commercializing cost-effective, large-scale fuel cell and electrolytic cell products by utilizing their core technology and advanced system engineering technology.

FCI's fuel cell is an optimized high-efficiency micro thermal power generation system which provides a fuel cell power generation system that supplies high-efficiency power and heat to homes, businesses, public buildings, and smart farms. Currently, commercialized product is RevGEN 1.5 with a capacity of 1.5 kW, which can be installed in homes and buildings. The power generation efficiency is about 55%, and the official explained that the total system efficiency combined with the heat recovery efficiency is more than 95%, providing the highest efficiency in Korea. In addition, it is possible to change power generation output and heat supply according to demand, and to provide specialized products for hybrid power generation with other power sources, which it can be widely used in the domestic and overseas building fuel cell market.

The application and utilization of these clean energy systems in the city center were implemented as a video by using 3D modeling, and they are planning present at the exhibition. They are not only showing FCI’s fuel cell system installed in the city to produce and supply electricity and heat, but also expressed by applying the concept of a virtual power plant (VPP) in the city. Through the virtual power plant, energy independence in the city can be realized by integrating and operating the fuel cell installed in the city and efficiently producing and consuming the generated electricity within the district. In addition, by selling surplus electricity to other districts, it is possible to generate additional revenue, realizing a society that rational coexistence can be achieved. Through this concept video, they intend to deliver the fuel display system more easily to visitors and indirectly provide the experience of a clean future city.

An official from FCI said, “We were established as a fuel cell specialized research company in 2018, and set a goal to lead to a global business based on the fuel cell and hydrogen industry at the beginning of the business. In particular, bearing in mind the situation that Saudi Arabia's circular carbon economy policy fits well with Korea's carbon neutrality and hydrogen economy policies, we tried to promote projects that match the policies of both countries.”

The explanation continued, “We are developing our business around the fuel cell field, which will play a key role as a future eco-friendly energy source, and we are focusing on developing the SOFC field, which has the most power generation efficiency and excellent technological growth potential among various fuel cell types. Our company was established with technical personnel who have accumulated long-term experience in the fuel cell field, including SOFC, and holds a number of related technology patents. In addition, we plan to secure a number of partners who want to expand business using eco-friendly energy sources in Korea and the Middle East, and with them, we plan to develop customized products that fit the environment of the target region together.”

FCI's product sales performance is expected to occur in earnest from 2023. They have signed a conditional purchase contract with Saudi Arabia's Taqnia Energy for 150MW for overseas sales. In Korea, they have secured a total of 363 MW of purchase intent, from S-OIL and 40 MW each for Seosan and Okcheon fuel cell power plants.

They also announced their future plans. An official said, “FCI is continuing R&D to expand commercial product lineup. We plan to release 45Kw and 240Kw large fuel cell (SOFC) products by 2024, which can be used for medium-to-large buildings, data centers, and power generation. In preparation for the future increase in demand for eco-friendly ships, we are also promoting the development of systems that can utilize our products as ship power.”

“As the demand for eco-friendly hydrogen is expected to increase rapidly in the future, we are also promoting the development of water electrolysis facility technology that can produce blue hydrogen/green hydrogen. From 2023, we plan to expand our business scope beyond Korea to the Middle East, the United States, and Europe, and develop customized products with local partners to supply our system to the region.”

‘CES’ is the world’s biggest IT trade show and is a place where one can see the direction and trends of the appliance industry of the entire world. Hosted by the Consumer Technology Association (CTA), it is held annually in Las Vegas, USA in January. Having reported on CES for 17 consecutive years, AVING News started reporting news of CES to the entire world since 2006, and conducted ‘BEST OF CES’, which chose the most innovative product and technology, and ‘BEST OF MADE IN KOREA, which chose the best innovative company in Korea. In addition, it vividly relayed on-site issues in CES through ‘AVING LIVE’.

The Seoul Technology Pavilion operated a Theme Zone which implemented elements of visions for the future and elements for experiences, as well as a Tech Zone which displayed the innovative technology of partnered large corporations and startups. The Seoul Business Agency (SBA) showcased the Seoul Technology Pavilion’s innovative technology in the field of ‘mobility and ESG’ in a large corporation connected open innovation method, and 7 startups possessing innovative technology in the relevant fields will be in participation.
